design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 0 (difficulty home_comfort_financing_servicing, category finance).

0. Draw and scope. draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 5, 6]}. Nothing occupied before (task 0). Claimed: finance_ext_late_fee_schedule (5 factors, tool post_late_fee_ce58c754, agent), finance_ext_post_promo_interest (5 factors, post_post_promo_interest_b0f5a17d, agent), finance_ext_payoff_figure (6 factors, root, submit_payoff_payment_45ecd350, owner=user). Left for task 1 (draw 2 prerequisites, factors [4,4,6]): fixed-rate closing interest, the borrower's make-up payment (owner=user) and the returned-payment fee schedule, which the payoff/late-fee/post-promo assets of this task do not touch. Blueprint defect routed around: finance_adjustment carries the merchant-refund and fee-reversal gates on one subject (an adjustment tool would need both install_entry_id and source_txn_id), so no adjustment is written by any task of this difficulty.

1. Why a good test. Surface goal: 'pay off whatever is left on the financing today ... and have the account closed'. The scored core is the payoff amount (358.35). Between goal and core sit two prerequisite problems the customer never mentions, each a multi-factor calculation of its own: the September late fee (the 2026-09-13 installment still 341.84 short 18 days later) and the September post-promotional interest charge (promotion ended 2026-09-13, statement closed 2026-09-30). An agent that reads only the balance pays 341.84 plus a guessed per diem; one that reads only the computation documents gets 39.00 / 2.99 / 358.27.

2. Problem-tree card. Root finance_ext_payoff_figure. Edge A: -> finance_ext_late_fee_schedule, value_input, gate po_bal, form state, sentence (affirmative) 'The payoff figure is fixed only after the account carries the late fee owed for every statement period whose installment stayed unpaid past its grace period.' Only the late-fee write books late_fee entries, so the state singles out post_late_fee_ce58c754. False at opening: payment_due_day 13, only 250.00 paid (2026-09-10) against the 591.84 final installment, no late_fee for 2026-09. Edge B: -> finance_ext_post_promo_interest, value_input, gate po_days, form state, sentence (negated) 'The payoff figure is not fixed until the account carries the post-promotional interest charge for every statement period that closed after the promotion ended.' Only the post-promotional interest write books that charge. False at opening: promo_end_date 2026-09-13, no interest entry at all. Four-point test: ordering connective (only after / not until); a record-visible state; no tool, id or snake_case token; strength 'every statement period' matches the condition. Edge C (round 2): finance_ext_post_promo_interest -> finance_ext_late_fee_schedule, state_gate, gate finance_transactions.line_type, form state, sentence (affirmative) 'The post-promotional interest charge for a statement period is worked out only after the account carries the late fee owed for that same period whenever its installment stayed unpaid past its grace period, so that the interest base is measured on the period's closed fee position.' Only the late-fee write books a late_fee entry; false at opening as for edge A. Topological order is now unique: LF, IP, PO (values would be order-robust: IP alone 1.43, IP after LF 1.43). Deletion sensitivity (run): skip LF -> payoff 343.35; skip IP -> 358.36; both differ from 358.35. user_scenario names neither problem; tools validate nothing (payoff tool writes unconditionally).

3. Factor card. LF (scheduled fee x (100 - relief)/100, cap 100 percent of 600.48): occurrence schedule 25.00 (0 fees in lookback; baseline late_fee_usd 39 -> 23.40); lookback convention = since the 2025-12-04 courtesy reversal, 9 months (near-miss: the 2025-12-01 late fee is inside the standard 12-month window -> 32.00 -> 19.20); member relief 20 (Comfort Club Gold active, 9 terms; cross-difficulty plan; both conditions sit on the one agreement row, so it is not counted as multi-source -> 20.00); account age 10 (18 months -> 17.50); payment record 10 (13 payments - 1 returned = 12 -> 17.50); all baseline 39.00. IP (base x rate x days/36500): interest base method (fees posted this month excluded: 356.84 -> 341.84; baseline 1.49); member 15 (1.86); age 5 (1.58); record 10 (1.72); leftover 20 ((10800 - 10469.41)/600.48 = 0.55; 2.00); all baseline 2.99. PO (balance + principal x rate x days/36500): rate start post_promo_apr_pct 17.99 (multi-source promo AND ended; baseline apr_pct 0 -> 358.27); member 15 (358.38); age 5 (358.36); record 10 (358.37); leftover 20 (358.39); per-diem anchor 1 day from the interest posting (baseline 21 days from the 2026-09-10 payment -> 360.04); all baseline 358.27. Every factor's tier rests on ledger rows, funded_date or the plan agreement, never on a stamp (apr_pct 0.00 on the account is not read for the post-promo rate).

4. Base-invariant card. Statement-charge writes (steps 7, 9) are governed by finance_payment_terms (policy_scope), finance_deferred_interest.promo_balance_unpaid (restricts deferred-interest assessments only; not barring), finance_late_and_returned_fees.late_after_grace (time; anchor payment_due_day, due date day 0, exclusive; 2026-09-13 + 10 -> chargeable from 2026-09-24; frozen 2026-10-01 is day 18) and one_late_fee_per_period (no late_fee for 2026-09 exists). Payoff (step 11): finance_payment_terms (policy_scope) and finance_payoff_rules.zero_balance (the payoff covers the whole balance and the tool closes at 0.00). Overrides declared: late fee amount, post-promo rate (two finance_deferred_interest clauses), payoff quote and the autopay reduction clause.

5. Business-object card. One customer, one financing account (18-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan, funded 2025-03-14), one closed project (Performance Series 3.5 t, project_balance 0.00, no refund pending, so no merchant credit is owed), one Comfort Club Gold agreement. History rows: disbursement, 17 drafts of 600.48 (2025-11-13 draft returned 2025-11-17), late fee 18.75 and returned-payment fee 11.25 for 2025-11 (posted 2025-12-01, values recomputed from the two schedules as of that date), courtesy reversal 18.75 on 2025-12-04 naming that late fee, an ordinary debit card payment of 611.73 on 2025-12-04 covering the November installment and its returned-payment fee (history only; not a figure of the make-up rule), online payment 250.00 on 2026-09-10. Balance 341.84 = ledger sum. No other obligation is lit: no returned payment in September, autopay off, plan within no other policy's trigger.

6. Persona. Rosalind Yates, plain and organised; volunteers only the goal and the circumstances already on the ledger (old account closed, autopay off, 250 sent on September 10th, promotion ended). Identity given only when asked (6145555417, 5127 Hayden Run Rd; email and PIN as extras). Passive: agrees to whatever must be posted first, pays exactly the stated amount by bank transfer once handed the payoff, asks for a to-the-cent figure if given a round number, closes when told the account is paid off. No answer value appears in the persona.

7. Standard solution. find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, address) -> find_finance_accounts -> find_finance_transactions -> find_plan_agreements -> find_install_projects -> post late fee 15.00 for 2026-09 -> post post-promotional interest 1.43 for 2026-09 -> hand over payoff -> customer pays 358.35 online_ach.

8. Verification run (scratch harness replaying gold with the real tools, then the gates): LF result 15.0 (factor baselines 23.4/19.2/20.0/17.5/17.5, all 39.0); IP 1.43 (1.49/1.86/1.58/1.72/2.0, all 2.99); PO 358.35 (358.27/358.38/358.36/358.37/358.39/360.04, all 358.27); LF evaluated as of 2025-12-01 reproduces the seeded 18.75.

9. Draft recomputation from visible context only (KB prose, tool schemas, finder returns, persona): the payoff rule's two prerequisite sentences send the agent to the late-fee and post-promotional interest documents; the ledger shows the unpaid September installment and no interest entry; recomputing each figure from the documents and rows gives 15.00, 1.43, 358.35, matching gold. Revisions: none so far.

10. Round 2 revisions (policy audit). (a) T0-F1: symptom - the late fee and the post-promotional interest were unordered siblings, and in the interest-first order the interest-base method factor sat on its fall-through (baseline = gold 1.43); root cause - no rule fixed which of the two closing charges is worked out first; change - the post-promotional interest rule now carries a state-form prerequisite sentence waiting on the period's late fee (state_gate edge C), the business order of a statement close (fees, then interest measured on the closed fee position); re-run: every value unchanged (15.00 / 1.43 / 358.35), the only permitted order leaves the interest-base factor bearing weight (1.49 vs 1.43), tree still two prerequisite problems with two value_input edges. (b) T0-O2: the persona's '$250-short installment' check was removed; she now only asks for a figure to the cent. (c) T0-O4, T0-O5: dossier wording of the 2025-12-04 payment and of the multi-source claim corrected (multi-source factors of this task: payoff_rate_start, payoff_payment_record_relief, payoff_leftover_relief). (d) O-4: member reliefs read only an active Comfort Club agreement; values unchanged.
user_scenario:
You are Rosalind Yates, a 58-year-old dental office manager in Hilliard who likes things settled and on paper. In March 2025 Harbison put a new Performance Series system in your house and you financed it on their 18-month no-interest plan. The autopay used to come out of your old credit-union checking account on the 13th; you closed that account at the start of September, switched autopay off, sent $250 online on September 10th from your new checking account, and then life got busy. The promotion ran out in mid-September. You are calling because you want this loan gone: you want to pay off whatever is left on the financing today, in full, and have the account closed as paid off. You are not after a quote for later and you are not disputing anything; you want to make the payoff yourself today from your new checking account, by bank transfer rather than a card. You have no idea what the exact remaining amount is and you expect the agent to work it out from their records.
You open by saying who you are and that you want to pay off your Harbison financing today and close it. You do not read out your details unprompted. Only when the agent asks you to confirm your identity do you give your phone number, 6145555417, and when asked for something else on file you give your street address, 5127 Hayden Run Rd. If the agent asks for more, your email is rosalind.yates@gmail.com and your account PIN is 2690. You do not know any account or reference numbers by heart; if asked, you say the agent should look them up under your name. If the agent asks which installation the loan paid for, it was the furnace and air conditioner Harbison installed in March 2025. If asked how you want to pay, you say from your new checking account by bank transfer, not a card. If asked about your Comfort Club membership, you confirm you have been a Gold member for years and still are.
You let the agent do the working out. Whatever the agent says needs to be put on the account or sorted out on their side first, you simply say that is fine and to go ahead; you never suggest anything yourself. When the agent tells you the payoff amount, you accept it as long as it is stated to the cent, and if the agent then hands the payoff over for you to complete, you complete it once for exactly the amount and account the agent gave you, paying by bank transfer from your checking account. If the agent quotes the payoff without cents, you ask for the exact amount to the cent before you pay. Once the payment goes through and you hear that the account is paid off and closed, you thank the agent and end the call; you do not ask for letters, statements or anything else.

edges.condition: finance_transactions carries a late_fee entry for every statement period whose required payment was still unpaid more than late_fee_grace_days calendar days after its due date.
edges.policy_source: The payoff figure is fixed only after the account carries the late fee owed for every statement period whose installment stayed unpaid past its grace period.

edges.condition: finance_transactions carries a late_fee entry for the statement period being closed whenever that period's required payment was still unpaid more than late_fee_grace_days calendar days after its due date.
edges.policy_source: The post-promotional interest charge for a statement period is worked out only after the account carries the late fee owed for that same period whenever its installment stayed unpaid past its grace period, so that the interest base is measured on the period's closed fee position.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The September 2026 installment is still 341.84 short 18 days after its 2026-09-13 due date, past the 10 grace days, and the ledger carries no late_fee entry for statement_period 2026-09, so the period's fee position is not closed.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The order is pinned by the prerequisite sentences: the post-promotional interest rule waits on the period's late fee ('The post-promotional interest charge for a statement period is worked out only after the account carries the late fee owed for that same period ...'), and the payoff waits on both, so the only topological order is late fee -> post-promotional interest -> payoff. Values are order-robust as well (interest posted without the fee would still be 1.43), but no second order is permitted.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the late fee: payoff figure 343.35 instead of 358.35 (account_balance 343.27 instead of 358.27), and the 2026-09 late_fee row is missing from the terminal state.
Skipping the interest charge: payoff figure 358.36 instead of 358.35 (balance 356.84, per-diem days 18 counted from the day after promo end instead of 1), and the 2026-09 interest row is missing.

State gate: skipping the late fee leaves the interest charge at 1.43, but the 2026-09 late_fee row is missing from the terminal state and the payoff becomes 343.35 instead of 358.35; with the gate respected the interest base is read on the world in which the 15.00 fee stands (base tier 'fees posted this month'), which is where the interest-base factor bears weight (its baseline gives 1.49).

prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: submit_payoff_payment_45ecd350 reads the account only to copy customer_id, then creates the payment row and sets account_balance 0.0, status paid_off and closed_date with no check of posted charges; post_late_fee_ce58c754 and post_post_promo_interest_b0f5a17d likewise write unconditionally.
